Precincts Reporting 18 of 18 ... Run Time 9:03 PM ... Run Date 03/03/2026', precinct '1-A ... Jasmine Crockett 2 49 27 78' (Election Day 27); CreationDate Mar 4 2026 03:03:46 UTC, ModDate 03:52:08 UTC (9:52 PM CST). 'Cumulative Results - unofficial' printed 8:53 PM. rationale: Primary END (election-night precinct report by printed run time), runoff LATER (election-night county totals only, uploaded 8:31 PM CDT), 2024 undetermined. Two different determined results give UNKNOWN.

comparison_notes.2026_primary: different: research UNDETERMINED, I say END (check 2). Same facts: the unofficial precinct report reads 'Election Night 3/3/26 ... Run Time 9:03 PM ... Run Date 03/03/2026' with election-day votes per precinct (ModDate 03:52 UTC = 9:52 PM CST), but its Last-Modified is Mar 27 2026 (re-upload). Research requires a night upload to prove publication; I applied the brief's check 2 reading that a printed run time on election night is evidence (as the brief allows for LATER, and as research itself accepted for Gillespie's runoff END with a creation time and no upload time). Difference in rule reading, not in facts. If the printed time is accepted, the county has END (primary) and LATER (runoff) and the tag is UNKNOWN; if not, research's single-election COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS (low) stands.
comparison_notes.2026_runoff: same (LATER, check 2): county totals run 8:19 PM, uploaded 01:31:11 GMT (8:31 PM CDT); no runoff precinct report.
comparison_notes.unsupported_claims: none found; research's facts match the files.
